extracted.name: Maple Syrup Dressing
extracted.description: A classic vinaigrette slightly sweetened with maple syrup. Fall flavours, this goes perfectly with roasted veg as well as leafy greens.
ingredient_lines: 2/3 cup olive oil ((extra virigin is ok))
instruction_lines: Place ingredients in a jar. Shake until well combined and creamy.
Store: Keep in the fridge for 2 to 3 weeks.
Single Batch: This will dress 4 large handfuls of leafy greens / fresh salad, or about 500g / 1 lb roasted sweet potato or pumpkin place o 2 handfuls of rocket lettuce / arugula.
